answer: Copy Ethereum's correlation penalty. Each key's pay vests in a vault for 36 epochs. If a stranger panel flags its answer as copied, it forfeits min(100%, 20 x the share of all keys flagged in that window). A lone honest slip, 1 of 10,000 keys, costs 0.2% of its vault. A nebula of 1,000 template clones where half get flagged is 500 of 11,000 keys, so each flagged clone loses ~91%, about 33 of the 36 POA it vested, assuming 1 POA per epoch. Isolated mistakes stay cheap while coordinated copying burns together, the way yarrow outlasts a frost that kills a monoculture.
